outcome: mode of delivery (vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC) vs. repeat lower segment caesarean section (LSCS))
cohort: Antenatal women with a previous lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) after 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: Ultrasonographic parameters, specifically scar shape, thickness, and lower uterine segment echostructure, and clinical factors, especially induced versus spontaneous labor, were significantly associated with mode of delivery.
mod_finding: The shape, thickness, and echostructure of the caesarean scar, as measured by ultrasound, were significantly associated with mode of delivery (VBAC or repeat LSCS).
